name: io.github.miketigerblue/proton-bridge-mcp
description: Hardened local MCP server exposing Proton Mail Bridge to Claude over loopback IMAP/SMTP. macOS Keychain credentials, TLS pinning, hash-pinned dependencies.

environment_variables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_TLS_POLICY
environment_variables.description: pinned | best_effort. Defaults to 'pinned' — the server refuses to start unless Bridge's TLS certificate is found and verified. Set to 'best_effort' only as an explicit downgrade for first-install diagnostics; it allows fallback to CERT_NONE on loopback.

environment_variables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_CERT_PATH
environment_variables.description: Path to the Bridge TLS cert (captured by bootstrap.py at ~/.config/proton-bridge-mcp/cert.pem).

environment_variables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_PASS
environment_variables.description: Bridge app-password fallback for headless / CI use. Prefer macOS Keychain (set automatically by bootstrap.py).

environment_variables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_ATTACHMENT_DIRS
environment_variables.description: Folders that proton_send_email and proton_create_draft may attach files from: absolute paths separated by ':'. Unset: every attachment is refused. Anything inside can be mailed out, so name a dedicated folder without secrets.

environment_variables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_MAX_ATTACHMENT_MB
environment_variables.description: Combined attachment size limit per message, in MB.
